title: Guidelines on the implementation of the transparency obligations for certain AI systems under Article 50 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689
citation: Commission Guidelines under Article 96(1)(d) AI Act
notes: Non-binding (draft Guidelines para 5: only the CJEU gives an authoritative interpretation of the Act). Issued under Article 96(1)(d) AI Act. Carries no enforceable primary Obligations of its own; its Terms interpret the Regulation's Terms via anchors. Published for stakeholder consultation closing 2026-06-03; on adoption, status moves to in-force and source should point to the adopted text.
